en: The postcard features a vibrant, color photograph of a well-dressed woman standing next to a donkey in a lush garden full of blooming flowers. In the background, there are wide, terraced steps leading up to a modernist building with large columns, above which a sign in Cyrillic reads 'КАЗИНО' (casino). There are fountains, trees, and a few other people visible, suggesting a lively public or resort area.
